name: beets
param_style: ? positional (Python sqlite3); SQL string-built by dbcore from the parsed query tree and sort objects
schema_source: reconstructed: the CREATE statements dbcore issues at startup (beets/dbcore/db.py _make_table/_make_attribute_table/_create_indices) over the Album/Item field sets (beets/library/models.py) and types (beets/library/fields.py, beets/dbcore/types.py)
data_scale: scale 1: 2,000 albums, 20,000 items (5% singletons), ~31k item_attributes, ~3.3k album_attributes
visibility_note: ~16k stars; the standard CLI music library manager, SQLite is its only store
interest_note: Every library read goes through one generic builder: a GROUP BY id derived table, an outer multi-key case-insensitive sort (COALESCE/NULLIF COLLATE NOCASE + TYPEOF CASE chains), and a second statement re-running the whole thing as IN (SELECT id FROM (...)) to fetch flexible attributes. Flexattr filters fall back to WHERE 1 (full sorted scan); path queries use || between comparisons.
